name: Philippines
shortSummary: India-Philippines ties have strengthened significantly through defence trade, highlighted by the Philippines becoming the first export customer for India's BrahMos supersonic cruise missile.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: BrahMos missile sales anchor a growing defence-industrial relationship.
Shared interest in freedom of navigation in the South China Sea.

majorChallenges.title: Limited trade volume
majorChallenges.description: Bilateral trade remains modest relative to India's other regional partnerships.

recentDevelopments.title: BrahMos missile deliveries and follow-on interest
recentDevelopments.description: Following the landmark 2022 BrahMos deal, the Philippines continued fielding the system and signalled interest in further defence acquisitions from India.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Cements India's emergence as a credible defence exporter and deepens strategic alignment amid shared South China Sea concerns.

historicalEvents.title: BrahMos Missile Export Deal
historicalEvents.description: The Philippines signs a $375 million deal to acquire the India-Russia jointly developed BrahMos supersonic cruise missile, India's first major missile export.
historicalEvents.impact: Marked a landmark moment for India's defence export ambitions and deepened strategic alignment amid shared concerns over the South China Sea.

agreements.name: BrahMos Supersonic Cruise Missile Deal
agreements.description: Philippines' acquisition of shore-based anti-ship BrahMos missile batteries from India.

defenceCooperation.name: BrahMos missile supply
defenceCooperation.description: India's first major cruise missile export contract.
